stories.title: Hershey names Amanda Almond as president, international By Investing.com
stories.summary: The Hershey Company has appointed Amanda Almond as its new President, International, effective October 12th. Almond brings over 30 years of experience in consumer goods and retail to the role, having previously served as regional managing director at Vinarchy and held senior leadership positions at Bacardi. She succeeds Rohit Grover, who is retiring after 27 years with Hershey.

stories.title: The Hershey Company Names Amanda Almond President, International
stories.summary: The Hershey Company has appointed Amanda Almond as President, International, effective October 12, 2026. Almond, with over 30 years of experience in consumer goods, will succeed Rohit Grover, who led the international division for eight years. Her appointment aims to accelerate Hershey's global growth and expand its iconic brands to more consumers worldwide.
